ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are four small latitude-longitude grid maps labeled A, B, C, and D in the figure. The top of small map C is marked with longitudes 105° and 110°, and the side of the horizontal lines is marked with latitudes 35° and 25°, indicating that region C is roughly located at 105°E-110°E, 25°N-35°N. Then reason: this latitude-longitude range corresponds to Southwest China, close to the Sichuan Basin and its surroundings. The Sichuan Basin has a humid climate, and moisture and heat conditions are relatively good, but it has many rainy and foggy days and relatively few annual sunshine hours, so the main limiting condition for agricultural development is light conditions.
